svg.title: Busy share and run queue from cumulative counters
svg.desc: A step workload on one CPU, its two kernel counters, and the per-second busy share and mean queue length derived from them.
svg.text: 1. Tasks runnable: one running (gold), the rest waiting (red)
2. The two cumulative counters: B(t) not idle, W(t) waiting
3. What a lane shows each second: busy share (gold bars), mean queue (red)
queue bars are clipped at 1.0 on this axis; the lane draws round(wait) red beads, at most 6
The sample interval sets only the time resolution: the counters never lose a burst, they lose when it happened.
